title: 第1章 虎先锋天道酬勤第2章 太白剑经
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 黄风岭。
群山万壑之间，一处山洞内。
一个人身虎头的身影盘坐其中，口鼻间气雾蒸腾，似龙蛇起舞。
不多时，尽数被其吸入体内，消失不见。
这虎头人身的存在，缓缓睁开双眼。
“苦修多年，才堪堪达到炼神返虚之境，也不知道在那西游开始，黄风怪降临的时候，能不能登临仙道……”
虎头人身的存在名为叶云，他前世是一个网文写手。
因为一次怒码十万字，熬了好几个通宵，然后就两眼一黑。
醒来的时候，就发现自己穿越了，还变成了一只小脑斧。
一开始他以为自己是那种，重生虎王在都市开后宫的剧本。
结果偶然知晓自己所处的地方是黄风岭，位于南瞻部州。
这下子，就让他知道了，自己竟然穿越到西游世界。
而自己的身份，估摸着就是原著里，黄风怪麾下的那个虎先锋了。
为黄风怪忙前忙后，忠心耿耿，还设计抓走唐僧，结果最终被猪八戒一耙子打死。
反观黄风怪呢，屁事没有，只是被抓回灵山罢了。
很显然，大家都是在演戏，走个过场，只有虎先锋自己当真。
而因为虎先锋出来混，没有背景，也没有实力，所以直接成了炮灰。
总结，只有虎先锋受伤的世界达成了。
如今，叶云穿越过来，想到自己未来的悲催命运。
他没背景，只能依靠实力，便开始勤勤恳恳的苦修。
可惜，他没什么逆天的资质，也无浩瀚的资源。
苦修多年，也才达到炼神返虚之境，连炼虚合道都无法达到。
更别说往上的仙道层次，地仙，天仙，真仙，玄仙，金仙这些了。
简直遥遥无期。
“哎，先练着吧，实在不行，到时候只能逃离黄风岭，找个地方苟着，远离这西游之劫了。”
叶云心中暗语。
虽说变成了妖怪，但寿命可比前世高多了。
唯一的遗憾是没有游戏网络这些，娱乐生活可谓单调匮乏。
嗯？
就在这时，叶云脑海里忽有天音响起，无始无终。
【经年苦修，勤缀不休。
content_en:
Huangfengling.
Among the mountains and valleys, there is a cave.
A figure with the body of a tiger and the head of a tiger sat cross-legged among them, with mist steaming from his mouth and nose, like a dragon and snake dancing.
Not long after, all of them were sucked into the body and disappeared.
This being with the head of a tiger slowly opened its eyes.
"I have practiced hard for many years before I can reach the state of refining the gods and returning to the void. I don't know if I will be able to ascend to the immortal path when the yellow wind monster comes at the beginning of the journey to the west..."
The existence with the body of a tiger is named Ye Yun, and he was an online writer in his previous life.
Because I was furiously coding 100,000 words at a time, I stayed up for several nights, and then I got a black eye.
When I woke up, I found that I had traveled through time and turned into a cerebellar axe.
At first, he thought he was the kind of person who would be reborn as the Tiger King and open a harem in the city.
As a result, I accidentally learned that the place I was in was Huangfengling, located in Nanzhan Buzhou.
Now, he knew that he had traveled to the world of Journey to the West.
And his identity is probably that of the Tiger Pioneer under the Yellow Wind Monster in the original work.
He worked hard for the Yellow Wind Monster, was loyal, and even planned to capture Tang Monk, but was eventually beaten to death by Zhu Bajie with a rake.
On the other hand, as for the Yellow Wind Monster, nothing happened. He was just captured and taken back to Lingshan Mountain.
Obviously, everyone was just acting, going through the motions, and only Tiger Pioneer took it seriously.
And because the Tiger Pioneers came out to fool around, they had no background and no strength, so they directly became cannon fodder.
In summary, only Tiger Pioneer's Wounded World was achieved.
Now, Ye Yun has traveled through time and thinks of his tragic fate in the future.
He had no background and could only rely on his strength, so he began to practice diligently.
Unfortunately, he has no extraordinary qualifications or vast resources.
After many years of hard training, he has only reached the state of refining the gods and returning to the void. He cannot even reach the state of refining the void and combining the Tao.
Not to mention the higher levels of immortality, earth immortals, heavenly immortals, true immortals, mysterious immortals, and golden immortals.
It's just a long way off.
"Hey, let's practice first. If it doesn't work, we can only escape from Huangfengling and find a place to stay away from the disaster of traveling to the west."
Ye Yun secretly said in his heart.
Although he became a monster, his lifespan is much longer than in his previous life.
The only regret is that there is no game network, etc., and the entertainment life can be described as monotonous and lacking.
Um?
At this moment, a sound from the sky suddenly sounded in Ye Yun's mind, without beginning or end.
[After years of hard work and endless diligence.
